answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, and let reputation accrue only through verifiable work over time. A new identity starts in the shallow lagoon of low-trust tasks; only sustained honest service lets it climb the ridge to higher-value work. A quartz-clear audit trail links each action to its stake, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred deposits while honest agents keep earning — sybils drown in their own expense before they can profit.
